purpose: Roll-channel feasibility of the flight-controller construction route
source_selection: 4 per partial quality level; short/medium/long delay plus random fourth; no outcome filter
teacher_selection: minimum mean validation-command RMSE on same plant; never test
failed_teachers: retain all source objects and all seeds; report failures and student outcomes without deletion

student.aggregation: all previous training observations retained; labels from current source plant teacher
student.selection: source plants with validation commands only

evaluation.tracking: full response from command onset; same-time reference/output
evaluation.oscillation: post-release RMS, peak envelope/settling with explicit censoring; no formal modal-grade claim

adaptation.target: DHC-6 discrete ARX simulation identified from recorded MAT data
adaptation.fit_record: prbs_A6 first 30 s per adaptation condition
adaptation.evaluation_fit: chirp_A10; held out of policy fitting
adaptation.exposure: 8 x 30 s target identification plus model-based optimization; not 64 real flight interactions
adaptation.selection: final fixed-budget checkpoint; no test-based choice

statistics: report every seed; plant-paired comparisons; no population-level significance claim from three seeds
